name: Sensors
author: Nikolay Yasinskiy
description: A thermometer in the bar with the processor temperature next to it, and a popup of every temperature sensor: processor, graphics, memory, drives and fans.

barWidget.description: Processor, graphics, memory and drive temperatures, and fan speeds.

schema.label: Show temperature
schema.description: Show the processor temperature next to the thermometer.

schema.label: Warning temperature (°C)
schema.description: Processor and graphics count as too hot from this temperature. Drives and memory use the limits their drivers report.

schema.label: Notify when too hot
schema.description: Send a notification when a sensor reaches its limit.
